categories.name: Brand safe
categories.question: Would a mainstream household brand be comfortable appearing beside this website or app's content without having to explain itself? Judge trust rather than topic: serious journalism, health information, and edgy comedy count as brand safe when they are honest and treat the audience with respect. Deceptive claims, harassment, hate, and content that exists mainly to shock or provoke are not brand safe, whatever the subject.

categories.name: Primary purpose
categories.question: What is the main purpose of the website or app? Select Unknown if the evidence is insufficient.
